body:
Quick mode — no voting panel. Rounds 1-3: up to 6 Cursor specialists in parallel (plan-fidelity when plan available) + generic Codex. Main agent reviewed findings across 1 round.

Round 1: 4 Cursor specialists (structure, security, edge-cases, plan-fidelity) + generic Codex returned results (2 slots timed out without provenance marker). Accepted 4 findings folded inline: sort-by-publishedAt for release selection, gh-release-view for verification, SKILL.md dry-run caveat, SKILL.md halt instruction. No findings classified as OOS.
